title: trochera aphylla
intro: Trochera aphylla, commonly known as the 'Balsam Fir', is a type of evergreen coniferous tree native to the mountainous regions of North America. The health benefits of Trochera aphylla include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate respiratory issues, and act as an antioxidant, protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Trochera aphylla include its use in traditional medicine to treat coughs, colds, and flu, as well as its application in aromatherapy to promote relaxation and reduce stress. Bioactive constituents of Trochera aphylla include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
